title: Turn the strategy into a roadmap of bets
summary: A strategy roadmap shows the bets, the outcomes they aim for and roughly when, without promising every feature and date.

beginner: Write each bet as an outcome to achieve.
Place the bets in Now, Next and Later.
Add how you will know each bet is working.
Show what is not on the roadmap and why.
Share it with the sponsor and the teams.
intermediate: Size each bet by how much time it is worth.
Show dependencies between bets and teams.
Plan checkpoints to continue, change or stop each bet.
experienced: Combine roadmaps across teams into one strategic view.
Link bets to budgets and people.
Keep the roadmap honest as plans change.

toolExamples.miro: Lay out bets in Now, Next and Later columns.
toolExamples.jira: Track each bet as an initiative linked to team work.

pitfalls: Turning bets back into a feature list
No checkpoints to stop a failing bet
